newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed in subdued start to week.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed in subdued start to week.

text.p: London shares opened mixed on Monday as shares tracked sideways in a quiet, cautious opening to the week, traders said.
While 4,000 remains in sight, a thin economic and corporate diary is likely to keep trading subdued today and in early trading shares had added just 1.7 points to 3,948.1.
Key U.S. jobs data on Friday are expected to further cap activity in a busy week for U.S. economic figures and to keep interest rate concerns to the fore.
Domestic economic data is limited to September M0 and consumer credit due at 0830 GMT.
